Behaviour criteria for dsh-living-memory — the public counterpart of the author's own word list.
Load order: (1) ~/.dsh/dsh-living-memory/criteria-rules.json  (2) this file  (3) the CRIT_FLOOR built into index.cjs.
Semantics: PER KEY — the first readable layer that provides a key wins for that key; the built-in floor only
fills keys no layer provided. The floor is NOT appended: these are behaviour criteria, not security rules —
it keeps a feature usable, it does not keep a defence unbreakable. Override the first path with
LEGION_CRITERIA_RULES_PATH (handy for drills and sandboxes).
Fields: { re: regex source string, flags: JS regex flags }.

Why the words differ from the author's own list: that list doubles as an internal taxonomy (ruling /
pending-approval / field-report vocabulary and so on). This file keeps the BEHAVIOUR and drops the
taxonomy — generic wording a user may actually type is kept, site-specific terms are replaced by their
public counterparts. Add your own domain words here (or in the user file); never patch index.cjs.

Keys: metaExclusion (entries ABOUT facts are not evidence of facts) | intentGate (a short query that
still carries intent) | stashHint (a todo that looks like an open item) | taskCompleted (a tool call
arguing a task finished) | recallStopwords (filler words stripped before judging title recallability) |
inboxPath (a path that reads as an inbox) | exemptShort (one-word acknowledgements are not real turns) |
alertFamily (title-prefix families filed once per family) | sysAutoPrefix (fully automatic entries, whose
mutual collisions are exempt from conflict filing).

Disclosures kept HERE on purpose (the maintenance `_note` fields never ship, so anything that must be
readable in the package belongs in this comment):
  - alertFamily: the author's third branch is deliberately TRIMMED in the public build. It belongs to a
    patrol stage this package does not ship, so the branch would be permanently false; two branches ship.
  - opsHook / sentryCritical (added 2026-09-12): both are behaviour criteria that used to live as source
    literals. Their public word lists are public counterparts (not translations of the author's internal
    vocabulary); the author's own list is kept on the author's side. Put your own domain words in the
    user-level file rather than editing index.cjs.
  - guard rules (2026-09-12): the per-rule maintenance notes were dropped from this file (same policy
    as above), so the one trade-off worth knowing is stated here: the assignment-form credential pattern
    can also trip on PROSE that discusses such an assignment (e.g. documentation about keys). Narrow it in
    your own rules file if that matters for your corpus.
  - coverage ledger (2026-09-12): 11 criteria keys are externalised here. Four further behaviour regexes
    are deliberately REMOVED / TRIMMED / INERT in the public build rather than externalised (route words
    for the author's own workspaces, and a legacy-path sentinel whose pattern is inert here). Earlier
    release notes credited a single figure of 9 occurrences as the whole criterion surface; that
    accounting is superseded by this ledger.

alertFamily.re: ^(handover note警报|记忆链路light sentry警报)

exemptShort.re: ^(继续|同意|好|嗯|行|可以|OK|ok|多谢|谢谢|收到|是|对|continue|sure|yes|thanks|yep|nope)\s*[。.!！~～]?$

intentGate.re: [0-9一二三四五六七八九十]{1,4}\s*(月|日|号|点|时|次|条|个|d|h|分)|最近|今天|昨天|上周|上月|之前|之前那|上次|昨天那|刚才|进度|状态|报(告|表)|怎么|如何|什么|哪|谁|是否|还|继续|接(手|续|令|着)|查|找|搜|看|列|盘|总|结|汇|对比|差异|回(顾|顾下|执)|复(盘|跑|核)|待办|进行|在办|完成|毕|验收|呈|批|裁|令|案|车|窗|库|表|面板|通道|插件|模型|参数|配置|路径|版本|行号|文件|目录|备份|快照|回归|演练|审计|nightly patrol|living memory|记忆|检索|注入|提炼|写入|召回|分词|词表|权限|红线|hard rule|纪律|space|模块|工程|施工|重启|挂载|\b(?:\d+\s*(?:d|h|days?|hrs?|hours?|weeks?|months?|times?)|yesterday|today|tomorrow|recently|latest|last\s+(?:week|month|time|night|session)|ago|when)\b|\b(?:status|progress|pending|todo|done|complete[dt]?|finish(?:ed)?|verified?|audit(?:ed)?|review(?:ed)?|recap|summary)\b|\b(?:how|what|where|which|who|why|whose|whom)\b|\b(?:continue|resume|restart|find|search|look(?:up)?|list|show|check|compare|diff|track)\b|\b(?:memory|memories|recall|retriev\w*|inject\w*|extract\w*|index|schema|config\w*|plugin|model|version|backup|snapshot|patrol|nightly|session|window|panel|channel|permission|threshold)\b

metaExclusion.re: 盘点|清单|裁处|裁断|pending ruling|裁定|裁决|判定|剩.{0,4}条|field report|汇总|审计|复现|自检|escalate|方案|awaiting approval|草案|todo清理|待办清理|清理需区分|区分.{0,8}(真活|已闭环|被超越)|receipt|notify|交接|追加|log|open item|counter|\b(?:audit|checklist|inventory|summary|report|review|retrospective|handover|handoff|proposal|pending)\b

recallStopwords.re: 已?(完成|办毕|办结|完结|wrap-up|更新|记录|说明|情况|事项|内容|工作|小结|汇总|总结|备忘|备注|处理|日常|杂项|其他|临时|测试|验证|整理|自查)

stashHint.re: 候|待.{0,2}(批|裁|验|收|复|提)|counter|open item|提醒

sysAutoPrefix.re: ^(上下文压缩锚|handover note警报|Auto-Dreamer 语义簇)
